input.prompt: The camera itself is completely locked off and motionless like a tripod photograph, with absolutely no zoom, no push-in, no drift, no pan and no camera movement of any kind for the entire clip. The only motion anywhere in this shot is the mustard knit throw draped over the sofa arm, whose soft fringe sways gently and clearly as if touched by a light breeze. Every autumn leaf on the branches in the vase stays firmly attached and frozen in place. Everything else, including the sofa, cushions, lamp, vase and the poster, is completely still and motionless. Bright, warm, cozy Friday evening living room, interior magazine photography quality.
